digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter / capability detection and validation
propositions: capability-map validation must occur post-run and report unverifiable Epic-field contracts to run_metadata.json with non-zero exit, not silently accept them

capability call sites must be guarded at runtime with isinstance-primary and hasattr-fallback checks, reporting distinct outbound-capability-absent vs outbound-capability-raised outcomes on bridge_alerts rather than failing silently

the dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations, and related modules) must be deleted and the deletion recorded with operator rationale
runtime capability guards must handle Python 3.12+ __getattr__ proxying transports that isinstance alone cannot detect
live Jira DC harness regression is ruled out because no changed file is touched by any of the three landing commits and each passed full CI verification
